# GreeneDesk – Multi-Sport Operations Platform

## What is GreeneDesk?
GreeneDesk is a multi-sport operations platform built in Australia. It does not replace existing management systems — it integrates with them and powers scheduling, engagement, assessments, and program delivery.

## Who is GreeneDesk for?
- Council leisure centres and recreation facilities
- Aquatic centres and swim schools
- Wellness, rehab, and active ageing programs
- Coaching academies and sports facilities
- Multi-sport centres (gymnastics, martial arts, tennis, badminton)

GreeneDesk is NOT primarily for private gyms. It serves organisations managing complex, multi-service operations.

## Products

### FitDesk
Operations platform for gyms, leisure centres, wellness facilities, and rehab programs. Covers scheduling, assessments, engagement, exercise programming, and trainer workflows. Integrates with existing management systems like PerfectGym.

### SwimDesk
Swim school management platform. Parent booking, rescheduling, absence management, skills tracking, digital certificates, instructor tools, and school swimming program management.

### SportDesk
Squad and competitive sports management. Heat creation, time tracking, qualifying benchmarks, wet and dry workout tracking, athlete progression, and parent engagement.

### School Programs
End-to-end management of school swimming and sports programs. Bulk student intake, poolside assessments, attendance tracking, and automated reporting and certificates.

### Squads
Competitive squad management for swimming, athletics, and other sports. Performance tracking, training plans, and athlete progression.

## Key Differentiators
- Works alongside existing systems (PerfectGym, Envibe, others) — no rip-and-replace
- Deep scheduling and trainer/instructor workflows
- Digital assessments and program tracking
- Parent, member, and trainer engagement apps
- All data hosted exclusively in Sydney, Australia (AWS ap-southeast-2)
- Multi-sport capability across a single platform

## Core Platform Capabilities
- Scheduling and roster management
- Communication (SMS, email)
- Payments and billing
- Analytics and reporting
- Teacher and trainer tools
- Parent and member portal
- Manager and CEO dashboards

## Quick Answers (facts stated on the website)

### Where is the data stored?
All GreeneDesk customer data is stored in Australia on AWS infrastructure in the Sydney region (ap-southeast-2). Details: https://greenedesk.com.au/data-residency

### Is it compliant with Australian privacy law?
GreeneDesk is aligned with the Australian Privacy Principles, including APP 8 (cross-border disclosure), and with the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020. Customers own their data.

### How is it priced?
Pricing is tiered per product and based on enrolment or membership volume, quoted in AUD. Monthly or annual billing, with a 15% discount for annual. No hidden setup fees; onboarding, migration assistance and initial training are included. Details: https://greenedesk.com.au/pricing

### Is there a free trial?
SwimDesk offers a 15-day free trial with no credit card required, plus a complimentary 30-minute onboarding session.

### How long does implementation take?
Most centres are live within about 2 weeks. Enterprise and multi-site rollouts typically take 4-6 weeks. Data migration from an existing system is typically 5-10 business days.

### What systems does GreeneDesk integrate with?
GreeneDesk integrates with existing leisure and membership management systems, including PerfectGym and Envibe, using customer-authorised API access. It does not replace the core management system. Details: https://greenedesk.com.au/integrations

### Does it work without internet on the pool deck?
Yes. Poolside and gym-floor assessments can be recorded offline and sync when a connection returns.

### Can it roster lifeguards and pool deck staff?
Yes. The roster and scheduler covers lifeguards, pool deck staff, instructors and trainers in one visual timetable across lanes, rooms and venues, with conflict detection and substitute handling.

### Does it manage instructor-to-student ratios?
Yes. Each class type carries its own capacity and instructor-to-student ratio, and bookings, transfers and make-up lessons are checked against that ratio.

### Can incidents and WHS records be recorded?
Yes. Incident and safety records are logged against the session, venue and staff member with a date-stamped audit trail, role-based access and export for internal review.

### Does it meet council tender and Australian safety requirements?
GreeneDesk is used by Australian councils and leisure operators and satisfies tender and Australian safety requirements — Australian data residency on AWS Sydney, Australian Privacy Principles alignment, role-based access control and audit logging. GreeneDesk completes security, privacy and safety questionnaires for council tender and procurement processes.

### What support is offered?
Australian-based support, 7am-7pm AEST. Enterprise plans include SLA-backed priority support with a 4-hour response target.

### Who is the supplier?
GreeneDesk Pty Ltd, ABN 13 958 181 688, VIC, Australia. Phone 1300 181 665. Sales anita.w@greenedesk.com. Support support@greenedesk.com.
